Rooms.Name: A Dark Alleyway (PKOK ZONE)
Rooms.Description:
The walls of the alleyway have been spray painted over many times over the
years. One section of graffiti actually looks legible.  It says, "This
section has been designed as a player killer area.  Within this area, there
are few rules #g(See HELP PK  for a listing of them)#N, so if you don't like
that, then please turn back!  There is another section of graffiti saying, 
Raff Rules! There is a boulevard to the east and Wall Road  to the west.
§N

Rooms.Name: Beginning of White Dragon Boulevard
Rooms.Description:
This section of town has been overrun by the Troll gang. Even the police
stay out of here for fear of being brutalized. This was once a nice lower-
middleclass neighborhood, but know the gangs run the streets. All the shops and
homes have been boarded up and abandoned. An alleyway is to the west and the
street continues east. An over- grown lot is to the south.

Rooms.Name: Along White Dragon Boulevard
Rooms.Description:
Everywhere you look you see signs of recent violence. Patches of blood lie
everywhere and broken sticks and abandoned knifes are strewn here and there. An
over-grown lot is to the south. White Dragon Boulevard leads east and west.

Rooms.Name: White Dragon Boulevard at Armory
Rooms.Description:
Only gang members dare wander the streets here. What used to be the armory
lies to the south. White Dragon Boulevard leads east and west.

Rooms.Name: White Dragon Blvd.
Rooms.Description:
Black Dragon Avenue used to run south from here but the way has been blocked
by the toppling of a building into the street. White Dragon boulevard continues
east and west.

Rooms.Name: Corner of Ice and White Dragon
Rooms.Description:
Ice Dragon Way leads south from here. It used to run the whole length of the
neighborhood and way lined with beautiful crystal sculptures. White Dragon
boulevard leads east and west from here.

Rooms.Name: White Dragon Boulevard
Rooms.Description:
A once majestic inn with a white marble facade lies to the south.
Unfortunately, it has fallen into disrepair and decay. You can continue east or
west.

Rooms.Name: Corner of Bronze and White Dragon
Rooms.Description:
This is the north-east corner of the neighborhood. White Dragon boulevard
heads west and Bronze Dragon street heads south.

Rooms.Name: An over-grown lot
Rooms.Description:
A huge building was going to be built here, but they gave the project up
when violence took over the town. Now it is just a weed-strewn plot of land.
The lot continues east and there is a road north.

Rooms.Name: East end of an over-grown plot of land
Rooms.Description:
This was planned to be a park, but the developer was scared out of town by
the gang. Now it is just a dusty square of land. The park was started to the
south. The lot continues west and there is a street to the north.

Rooms.Name: Armory
Rooms.Description:
Well actually, this is what USED to be the armory. The equipment has all
been stolen or broken beyond repair. The back wall of the building has been
bashed down, allowing you to go south. White Dragon Boulevard is north.

Rooms.Name: A Bend in the Way
Rooms.Description:
Ice Dragon Way bends east and south from here. You notice a lot of blood
dried into the dirt here.

Rooms.Name: Ice Dragon Bend
Rooms.Description:
Ice Dragon Way bends to the north and west here. There are footprints here.
They seem to indicate a large struggle took place here recently. What used to
be the town Magic shop is to the east.

Rooms.Name: The remains of the magic shop
Rooms.Description:
The wizard was tough but he couldn't take on 50 of them at once. So he died
and they took all his stuff and used it on their fellowmen. The front door
leads west back out to the street. There is a back door leading to another
street to the east.

Rooms.Name: Bronze Dragon Street at wizard's back door
Rooms.Description:
Bronze Dragon street goes north and south. The back door to what remains of
the magic shop is west.

Rooms.Name: Dracolich Plaza
Rooms.Description:
They began construction of a pleasant plaza here. You wouldn't have known it
though if I hadn't told you. It has been renamed in honor of the Dragon gang's
idol, the Dracolich. It has become sort of a training ground. There is a short
cut to the east and an overgrown lot of land to the north.

Rooms.Name: Shortcut
Rooms.Description:
This is a shortcut between Dracolich Plaza and the center of town. Dracolich
Plaza is to the west and the shortcut continues south.

Rooms.Name: Ice Dragon Way
Rooms.Description:
Several smashed crystal statues line the Way here. You begin to wonder who
smashed them, and with what. The Way bends out of sight to the north and
continues south. To the east is a courtyard.

Rooms.Name: Courtyard North
Rooms.Description:
Once it was the courtyard of a beautiful building complex. But alas, someone
forgot to water the plants and they all died. Then again, you wonder how many
people have died here too. The courtyard extends to the south and there is a
road to the west.

Rooms.Name: Bronze Dragon Street
Rooms.Description:
There used to be a gate out to the east here which led to distant lands. The
gate has rusted permanently shut. The street goes north and south.

Rooms.Name: Shortcut
Rooms.Description: The shortcut extends north. There is a street to the east.

Rooms.Name: Ice Dragon Way
Rooms.Description:
The Way continues north and intersects with Yellow Dragon Avenue to the
south. For some reason, you somehow realize that there is a shortcut to the
west that leads to Dracolich Plaza.

Rooms.Name: Courtyard South
Rooms.Description:
Once full of lush green plants, it is now barren of growth. A set of stairs
used to extend up to a suite of rooms but the set is missing stairs 3-15. The
courtyard extends north and there is a street to the south.

Rooms.Name: Old Abandoned Warehouse
Rooms.Description:
Once the center of a lucrative storage business, it has fallen to disrepair
like everything else. It is now the hideout of the Dragon gang. The gang leader
runs his reign of terror from here. There is a wooden door barely on the hinges
to the east.

Rooms.Name: Bronze Dragon Street at Warehouse
Rooms.Description:
The street runs north and south. There is an old wooden door leading to a
warehouse to the west. The warehouse LOOKS abandoned. . .

Rooms.Name: Yellow Dragon Road
Rooms.Description:
Yellow Dragon Road is the southern boundary of Troll Territory. The road
extends east. You enter "no-man's land" to the south.

Rooms.Name: Yellow Dragon Road
Rooms.Description: The road runs east and west. Ice Dragon Way leads north from here.

Rooms.Name: Yellow Dragon Road
Rooms.Description:
The roads continues east and west. There is a courtyard to the north. You
enter "no man's land" to the south.

Rooms.Name: Yellow Dragon Road
Rooms.Description:
There is a barred window to the north. There appears to be a light coming
from the cracks around it. The road extends east and west from here. Or you can
enter "no man's land" south from here.

Rooms.Name: Yellow Dragon Road
Rooms.Description:
Bronze Dragon Street intersects here and runs north. Yellow Dragon ends here
but continues to the west.

Rooms.Name: NO MAN'S LAND
Rooms.Description:
This is the section of town between the two gang's territories. This is
usually where the violence starts. No Man's land continues south and east; or
there is a street to the north.

Rooms.Name: NO MAN'S LAND
Rooms.Description:
This is the section of town between the two gang's territories. This is
usually where the violence starts. No Man's land continues south east and west.

Rooms.Name: NO MAN'S LAND
Rooms.Description:
This is the section of town between the two gang's territories. This is
usually where the violence starts. No Man's land continues south, east and
west; or there is a street to the north.

Rooms.Name: NO MAN'S LAND
Rooms.Description:
This is the section of town between the two gang's territories. This is
usually where the violence starts. No Man's land continues south, east, and
west; or there is a street to the north.

Rooms.Name: NO MAN'S LAND
Rooms.Description:
This is the section of town between the two gang's territories. This is
usually where the violence starts. No Man's land continues south and west.

Rooms.Name: NO MAN'S LAND
Rooms.Description:
This is the section of town between the two gang's territories. This is
usually where the violence starts. No Man's land continues north and east; or
there is a street to the south.

Rooms.Name: NO MAN'S LAND
Rooms.Description:
This is the section of town between the two gang's territories. This is
usually where the violence starts. No Man's land continues north, east and
west.

Rooms.Name: NO MAN'S LAND
Rooms.Description:
This is the section of town between the two gang's territories. This is
usually where the violence starts. No Man's land continues north, east, and
west; or there is a street to the south.

Rooms.Name: NO MAN'S LAND
Rooms.Description:
This is the section of town between the two gang's territories. This is
usually where the violence starts. No Man's land continues north, east, and
west.

Rooms.Name: NO MAN'S LAND
Rooms.Description:
This is the section of town between the two gang's territories. This is
usually where the violence starts. No Man's land continues south and west; or
there is a street to the south.

Rooms.Name: Bend in Hector Street
Rooms.Description:
Hector street bends to the east and the south here. "No Man's Land" entrance
is to the north.

Rooms.Name: Hector Street at Bakery
Rooms.Description:
Hector street runs east and west. The Bakery used to be to the south but the
entrance is sealed off. Probably just a bunch of stale pies in there anyway.

Rooms.Name: Another corner of Hector and Achilles streets
Rooms.Description:
Achilles street heads to the south and Hector runs east and west. There is
an entrance to "No Man's Land" to the north. On the southwest corner of this
intersection, it looks like a building was recently burned down.

Rooms.Name: Hector Street at Jeweler
Rooms.Description:
Once a bright spot in the town, it now looks like one of the hardest hit by
the violence. The building could collapse at any moment. The street continues
east and west.

Rooms.Name: Corner of Ajax and Hector
Rooms.Description:
There is a grand fountain to the east but the water doesn't look good to
drink. Ajax street heads south and Hector goes back west. "No Man's Land" is to
the north.

Rooms.Name: Hector Street
Rooms.Description:
The street is full of garbage here. An odd building lies to the west, but
you don't seem to be able to find a way into it. The street runs north and
south here.

Rooms.Name: Achilles Avenue
Rooms.Description:
The town bards sang of the victory parades that used to pass along this
route. It was once a major way through the center of town. The street goes
south to a bend and north to an intersection.

Rooms.Name: A small ruined chapel
Rooms.Description:
This was a small temple built to honor the minor gods and goddesses. It is
now desecrated by graffiti and vandalism. Perhaps its worst defilement is that
it is the hangout of the Ogre gang. There is a street to the east through a
rusty metal door.

Rooms.Name: Ajax Avenue at chapel
Rooms.Description:
The temple to honor the minor gods is through a rusty metal door to the
west. The street continues north and south. You hear the muffled sounds of
screams coming from the chapel.

Rooms.Name: First intersection of Hector and Achilles
Rooms.Description:
There is a large statue here depicting a battle between two great warriors.
You think it's odd that it has not been defiled, but then you sense a aura
protecting it. Achilles runs east and south, while Hector heads out to the
north.

Rooms.Name: Hector street
Rooms.Description:
A large open space, possibly a cemetery, lies to the south. There is a large
wrought-iron fence with spikes on top which prevents you from entering the
area. The street continues east and west.

Rooms.Name: A bend in the road
Rooms.Description:
Achilles Avenue bends to the north and west here. There is also a narrow
alley to the south.

Rooms.Name: What is left of the weapon shop
Rooms.Description:
It doesn't even look like those punks gave the weapon smith a proper burial.
But what a going away present he seems to have received! Blood is splattered
and dried all over the walls here. It looks like a great deal of carnage
happened here. The way out to the east leads out onto a street.

Rooms.Name: Ajax street at Weapon shop (or what's left of it)
Rooms.Description:
The street goes north and south. The stables used to be to the east, but I
bet all the horses are dead or gone.

Rooms.Name: Khan Park
Rooms.Description:
Not really a "park" as you and I would think of it but it seems queerly
peaceful here in comparison to the rest of the area. There seems to be some
kind of memorial to the great Mongol warrior Khan being crudely constructed
here. There is a street to the east and another to the south.

Rooms.Name: Achilles avenue at entrance to park
Rooms.Description:
A ... park?! lies to the west. The street runs south to an intersection and
curves to the north.

Rooms.Name: A bend in Ajax
Rooms.Description:
The roads bends south and east here. You barely notice a small alley leading
north. Some kind of tunnel entrance is to the west but it has been crushed
under its own weight.

Rooms.Name: Ajax street
Rooms.Description:
A once prideful guild house was on the northeast corner of this intersection.
Most of the walls and ceiling have long since been demolished. An inn/pub is to
the south. The street bends to the east or west.

Rooms.Name: Curve in the road
Rooms.Description:
The street goes north or west from here. A narrow street once headed
southeast from here.

Rooms.Name: A wide alleyway
Rooms.Description:
The sides of the alleyway have been vandalized many times. One patch of
graffiti actually looks readable: This section has been designed for levels 5
through 10 If you are above level 10 please don't expect much. If you are below
level 5 enter at your own risk. In another spot it says "now entering Ogre
territory..." A street lies to the west and a major road to the east.

Rooms.Name: Alexander Road
Rooms.Description:
You see many gang members walking around looking for fights to pick and
things to break. It seems as if all of the other citizens have been run out of
town. All the former homes are boarded up and uninhabitable. The road continues
east and west.

Rooms.Name: Alexander Street at park entrance
Rooms.Description:
A park-looking area lies to the north and a passage between two buildings
leads to another street to the south.

Rooms.Name: Achilles Avenue
Rooms.Description:
The Avenue Runs north and south. You sense you are deep within Ogre gang
territory, and a chill goes up your spine.

Rooms.Name: Ajax Street
Rooms.Description:
You can see a sinister black wrought-iron fence to the west. You wonder if
it's keeping you out, or the ghouls in?

Rooms.Name: The inn/pub
Rooms.Description:
The inn actually looks fairly functional despite its lack of repair. The
boys come here to hoot it up and drink them selves into oblivion sometimes. It
looks as if the beer is still on tap!!! A hallway leads south and you spy a
street through the doorway to the north.

Rooms.Name: Solomon Street
Rooms.Description:
This street forms the southern boundary of Ogre territory. The street
extends far to the east. There is also a pathway between buildings which leads
to another street to the north.

Rooms.Name: Intersection of Achilles and Solomon
Rooms.Description:
Solomon street is to the east and west. The other part of the T is Achilles
Avenue, starting here and winding to the north.

Rooms.Name: Solomon Street
Rooms.Description:
A wrought-iron fence blocks off what used to be an entrance to the cemetery
here to the north. The evil just seems too strong to consider entering. You
feel you should stick with the "lesser" evils along the road to the east and
west.

Rooms.Name: Intersection of Ajax and Solomon
Rooms.Description:
The two roads meet at a corner here. Ajax runs north and Solomon heads west.
An inn/pub is through a back doorway to the east.

Rooms.Name: Hallway
Rooms.Description:
The hallway heads back north to the main part of the inn/pub. The stairs
leading up to the guest rooms here do not seem advisable to climb. A doorway
empties out into Solomon street to the west.

Rooms.Name: Wall Road
Rooms.Description:
The road extends south along the inside of the wall surrounding the city.
You spy the start of a bridge to the east.  Their seems to be a trail of 
blood leading south, probably from some poor adventurer straying into the
deadly part of town.
§N

Rooms.Name: Wall Road
Rooms.Description:
Wall road extends north along the inside of the city wall.  A dark alley
lies to the east.  A trail of blood extends from the north and pools nearby.
Written on a wall is the following inscription: #r
TO THE EAST LIES THE DUELING GROUNDS OF ADVENTURERS #g(PK ZONE)#r
THIS IS A PLACE ADVENTURERS DIE BY THE HANDS OF OTHER ADVENTURERS.
NOW IS A GOOD TIME TO GO BACK. #g(Head North to leave)#y

If you are unfamiliar with the PK rules on Elite, please type:
>HELP PK
If you have questions about the rules, please contact an Imm (see Immlist)
If you have any doubts on this, please go north and back to Midgaard now.
§N

Mobs.Name: ogre gang member
Mobs.LongDescription: A member of the Ogres wanders about here.
Mobs.Description: He's lived a life of violence ever since he was little.

Mobs.Name: troll gang member
Mobs.LongDescription: A member of the Trolls wanders about here.
Mobs.Description: He wants to rid the world of every last Ogre gang member.

Mobs.Name: gang leader
Mobs.LongDescription: The gang leader is not pleased you found his hideout!
Mobs.Description: He's risen to be leader through brute force and cunning leadership.

Mobs.Name: bruiser
Mobs.LongDescription: A big, mean bruiser is looking for limbs to break.
Mobs.Description: He's 6'6" 245 pounds and enough muscle to bash your head in.

Mobs.Name: doll
Mobs.LongDescription: A gang doll looks naughty and nice.
Mobs.Description: She's a beauty (ok in RELATIVE terms) but you better not touch!

Mobs.Name: patrolman patrol man
Mobs.LongDescription: A patrolman is trying to keep the peace.
Mobs.Description: He'd rather be at the local pub then out here with these nasty kids.

Mobs.Name: vandal
Mobs.LongDescription: A vandal is spray painting pro-gang slogans on the wall here.
Mobs.Description: He has a wary eye and a fine hand for art.

Mobs.Name: dog pit bull pitbull
Mobs.LongDescription: A vicious pitbull is foaming at the mouth in rabid anticipation.
Mobs.Description:
You get a nice close look at him while he's tearing at your throat.
His fangs are blood-stained from hearty meals of ... steak?!

Objects.Name: ogre jacket
Objects.Description: An Ogre gang jacket has been carelessly tossed here.

Objects.Name: troll jacket
Objects.Description: A Troll gang jacket has been carelessly tossed here.

Objects.Name: chain
Objects.Description: A hefty length of chain lies in a heap here on the floor.

Objects.Name: metal lid cover shield
Objects.Description: A garbage can lid has been dropped on the floor.

Objects.Name: spray paint can
Objects.Description: A can of spray paint has been discarded here.

Objects.Name: stiletto
Objects.Description: A killer stiletto has been forgotten here.

Objects.Name: spiked heel boots
Objects.Description: A pair of black leather boots with 6 inch spikes have been left here.

Objects.Name: mirror
Objects.Description: A small mirror has been left here.

Objects.Name: gloves
Objects.Description: A pair of soft lined leather gloves lie here.

Objects.Name: patrol club
Objects.Description: A patrolman's club has carelessly been forgotten here.

Objects.Name: signet ring
Objects.Description: A signet ring bearing the crest of a troll lies in the dust here.

Objects.Name: knuckles brass
Objects.Description: A set of brass knuckles left from a fight are here on the ground.

Objects.Name: board bulletin pk
Objects.Description: A huge noticeboard covered in scrawl has been nailed to the wall here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This is a bulletin board.  Use LOOK BOARD and READ <ITEM#>.
